resources.title: Official SAT Practice (Khan Academy)
resources.description: Full-length practice and skill drills built with College Board. Khan Academy content is published under CC BY-NC-SA.

resources.title: Bluebook: digital test app
resources.description: The official application used on test day. Install it to rehearse the exact digital test interface.

resources.title: Digital SAT Suite: what to expect
resources.description: Official structure: module lengths, timing, adaptive second modules and the built-in calculator.

resources.title: PSAT/NMSQT and PSAT 10 overview
resources.description: Assessment structure, timing and scoring for the PSAT/NMSQT; a useful companion for PSAT 10 and PSAT 8/9 practice.

resources.title: SAT Suite Question Bank
resources.description: Searchable bank of real released questions. Read-only: College Board's terms do not permit re-hosting these items, so HDSAT links to it instead of importing it.

resources.title: Desmos Graphing Calculator
resources.description: The same graphing calculator embedded in Bluebook. Practise with it here, or use the HDSAT Desmos Lab page.

resources.title: Desmos API documentation
resources.description: How the embeddable calculator API works, including the options HDSAT's Desmos Lab uses.

resources.title: Digital SAT Math reference sheet
resources.description: The reference sheet provided inside the digital test. HDSAT renders the same formulas in its in-test reference panel.

resources.title: OpenStax College Algebra 2e
resources.description: Peer-reviewed open textbook, CC BY 4.0. Chapters 2, 5 and 7 map closely onto the Algebra and Advanced Math domains.

resources.title: OpenStax Statistics
resources.description: CC BY 4.0 coverage of data displays, probability and inference for the Problem-Solving and Data Analysis domain.

resources.title: OpenStax Writing Guide with Handbook
resources.description: CC BY 4.0 guidance on argument, evidence and revision for the Reading and Writing section.

resources.title: Purdue OWL: grammar and punctuation
resources.description: Clear reference pages on sentence boundaries, pronoun agreement, modifiers and verb forms for Standard English Conventions.

resources.title: Purdue OWL: using evidence and citation
resources.description: How to integrate evidence into an argument, useful for Information and Ideas and Expression of Ideas questions.

resources.title: Khan Academy: Grammar
resources.description: Video and practice sequence for the conventions tested in the Writing portion of the digital Reading and Writing module.

resources.title: Khan Academy: Statistics and probability
resources.description: Interactive units on scatterplots, two-way tables, probability and sampling.

resources.title: Khan Academy: Algebra 2
resources.description: Sequences, polynomial and rational functions, exponentials, logarithms and trigonometry.

resources.title: Wolfram MathWorld
resources.description: Reliable definitions and identities when a formula reference sheet is not enough.

resources.title: College Board: SAT fee waivers and test-day policies
resources.description: Official registration, accommodation and fee-waiver information so practice planning matches real test logistics.
